actions.action: Select GitHub Actions as the GitHub Pages publishing source.
evidence_required: A push-triggered run reaches 'Configure Pages' with conclusion success
stop_conditions: The account cannot enable Pages on a private repository
actions.fallback: The guide stays reviewable in-repo; every stage page is readable on GitHub.

actions.action: Review and merge the seven open pull requests. Only one ordering constraint exists: #24 is based on #22, so #22 merges first. #19, #20, #21, #25 and #28 are independent.
prerequisites: CI green on each head SHA
evidence_required: CI conclusion success per head SHA
stop_conditions: A pull request's head SHA has no CI run
A rebase changes a head after its review
actions.fallback: Merge the subset that is reviewed; the remainder stays open and main is unaffected.

actions.action: Answer the binding-authority question in issue #15: does UniTrust ever commit an insurer to cover, or is every bind a request requiring separate insurer confirmation?
prerequisites: Access to a practising broker or the UniTrust principals
evidence_required: A written answer per tenant, recorded against the architecture contract
stop_conditions: The answer is assumed rather than obtained
actions.fallback: Freeze nothing that depends on it, and record the dependency.

actions.action: Split the exit-gate rule into the four independent checks the audit recommended, including the INVERSE check, and key the outputs section on eyebrow text rather than id=produces.
evidence_required: Four checks implemented, each proven able to fail
stop_conditions: The naive single rule is adopted instead
actions.fallback: Leave the audit findings recorded and unenforced.
